annotations.title: Remind signers who have not signed

description: Re-send the signature request email to recipients who haven't signed yet (at most once an hour per recipient). Uses no extra envelopes.

api_key.description: An md2sign API key. When given, this call uses that key's account even if the connection is signed in as someone else, so pass it on every call when your human has more than one md2sign account (for example two businesses). Also use it if your MCP client cannot send an "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" header.

document_id.description: The document ID returned by create_draft, list_documents or create_document_from_template. Must be a sent document awaiting signatures.
